title: Oyster Bay Brewing Co.
specs: Located in historic Oyster Bay, minutes from Sagamore Hill and the harbor
A real working brewery with authentic brewing equipment and atmosphere
Offers a lineup of craft beers including Honey Ale, Barn Rocker Ale, IPA, Double IPA, seasonal and hard seltzers
Tasting room accommodates groups of 150 or more with flexible layout options
Private label beer brewing available for restaurants, country clubs, private organizations, and events
